stories.title: Singapore President Tharman Shanmugaratnam celebrates Deepavali with idiyappam challenge, highlights multicultural spirit
stories.description: Singapore President Tharman Shanmugaratnam took on a fun idiyappam-making challenge with local artiste Das DD during Deepavali celebrations, turning the festive occasion into a light-hearted gathering of food, laughter and cultural exchange. In a festive video shared on Instagram, President Tharman, accompanied by his wife Jane Yumiko Ittogi, Das DD and academic Dr Shaireen Selamat for an idiyappam-making challenge and a conversation about the popular traditional dish, also known as putu mayam in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia. The light-hearted interaction began with President Tharman introducing the challenge, saying, "This young man wants to challenge me in a competition to see who can make the better idiyappam." As the participants tried their hands at making the traditional steamed rice noodles, Jane reminded them that the preparation "must look like idiyappam", while Das DD celebrated his attempt, exclaiming, "Waaah! My mom will be so proud of me." President Tharman eventually declared the competition settled, followed by a high-five. Explaining the significance of food during Deepavali celebrations, the President said, "A must-do at Deepavali is to enjoy a classic Deepavali dish." He also shared his preference for the savoury version of idiyappam, served with sambar, sothi and other accompaniments that give it a traditional South Indian flavour.
